title: Vision2CAD: A Visual Agent Harness for Explicit Geometry Referencing and Localization in Parametric CAD Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.22688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating parametric CAD models requires accurate geometry and stable feature dependencies. Existing methods face challenges in selecting geometric references, interpreting sketch-plane local coordinates, and establishing sketch constraints to projected external geometry. We present Vision2CAD, a visual agent harness that combines vision-language model (VLM) reasoning with deterministic CAD kernel operations. An ID-based interface supports explicit geometry selection, a local-coordinate bridge converts view coordinates into sketch coordinates, and projected-edge localization supports external sketch constraints. These mechanisms establish feature dependencies within the supported modeling operations and constraint types. We also introduce the Geometry Explicit Reference Dataset (GERD), which aligned commands, geometry states and IDs at every modeling step. On GERD-EVL and a DeepCAD test subset, Vision2CAD improves mIoU by 11.1\% and 5

translated_title: Vision2CAD：用于参数化CAD建模中显式几何引用与定位的视觉代理框架
translated_abstract: 生成参数化CAD模型需要精确的几何形状和稳定的特征依赖关系。现有方法在选择几何参考、解释草图平面局部坐标系以及建立针对投影外部几何的草图约束方面面临挑战。我们提出了Vision2CAD，这是一个将视觉语言模型（VLM）推理与确定性CAD内核操作相结合的视觉代理框架。基于ID的接口支持显式几何选择，局部坐标桥接器将视图坐标转换为草图坐标，投影边缘定位支持外部草图约束。这些机制在所支持的建模操作和约束类型范围内建立特征依赖关系。我们还介绍了几何显式参考数据集（GERD），该数据集在每个建模步骤中对齐了命令、几何状态和ID。在GERD-EVL和DeepCAD测试子集上，Vision2CAD将mIoU分别提高了11.1%和5%（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Vision2CAD通过将视觉语言模型推理与确定性CAD内核操作相结合，并引入基于ID的显式几何选择、局部坐标桥接和投影边缘定位机制，显著提升了参数化CAD建模中的几何引用与定位精度。
en_tdlr: Vision2CAD combines vision-language model reasoning with deterministic CAD kernel operations, introducing ID-based explicit geometry selection, local-coordinate bridging, and projected-edge localization to significantly improve geometry referencing and localization in parametric CAD modeling.
